domain.label: Technology Readiness
domain.title: Operationally demonstrated. Self-assessed at Software TRL 7.
domain.summary: Diamond Gate's governed software-construction platform has been assessed against published NASA software Technology Readiness Level criteria and satisfies the TRL 7 threshold within the bounded platform definition. The disposition has since been strengthened by post-consolidation operational reconfirmation and a separate blinded governance evaluation.

claim.label: Software TRL 7
claim.title: The platform has moved from integrated testing into demonstrated operational feasibility.
claim.summary: The readiness claim is bounded to the governed software-construction platform: authority and intake, bounded execution, construction, continuity, recovery and qualification operating together in the real repository and automation environment.

practical.title: The machinery behind the work has been demonstrated where it actually operates.
practical.body: Diamond Gate is no longer relying only on architectural descriptions or isolated tests. The governed construction platform has repeatedly operated against real repositories, automation, candidate state, recovery conditions and product qualification. After substantial control-plane consolidation, the surviving system was exercised again through the real operating environment and separately evaluated under unseen governance conditions. Against published software TRL criteria, that strengthens the bounded self-assessment at TRL 7.
practical.boundary: This is a Diamond Gate self-assessment against published criteria. It is not a NASA certification, evaluation, affiliation or endorsement, and it does not assign TRL 7 to every research claim or product in the estate.

engineering.title: Key platform functions remain integrated with the operational environment after consolidation.
engineering.body: The assessed boundary includes canonical authority and intake, exact-state bounded execution, deterministic construction/materialization, continuity and successor handling, bounded recovery and requalification, and mandatory product-quality qualification. Those functions have been demonstrated while integrated with the actual GitHub repository and automation environment used by Diamond Gate. Subsequent post-consolidation operation and the separate Generation 3 blinded governance benchmark strengthen the evidence that the disposition does not depend on obsolete historical scaffolding.
engineering.boundary: TRL 7 is asserted only for the bounded governed software-construction platform. Active product development continues, so this is not a TRL 8 claim of a completed and fully qualified final system.

proof.title: Inspect the evidence behind the strengthened TRL 7 self-assessment.
proof.body: The evidence chain includes integrated capability demonstrations, exact-state execution, continuity and recovery, operational-host certification, mandatory quality qualification, post-consolidation operational reconfirmation and a separately bounded blinded governance evaluation. The assessment maps those demonstrated facts to published software TRL 7 criteria rather than inventing a Diamond Gate maturity number.
proof.proofState: Bounded self-assessment · Software TRL 7 · strengthened post-consolidation
proof.boundary: The evidence supports demonstrated operational feasibility for the assessed platform boundary. It does not establish NASA certification, external endorsement, TRL 8 completion, universal reliability or maturity of every Diamond Gate artifact.
